definitions.explanation: Describes accuracy or precision so remarkable that nothing can compare to it. A four-character compound (yojijukugo) combining 正確 (accurate) with 無比 (without equal).

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シュート→シュート：05926_shuuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正確無比|せいかくむひ}だ。
{正確無比|せいかくむひ}な⟦パス→パス：00340_pasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{得点|とくてん}→得点：04909_tokuten⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: He created a scoring chance with a pinpoint-accurate pass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正確無比|せいかくむひ}な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ひとつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げられる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the craftsman's unparalleled precision, each part is finished to perfection.

notes:
USAGE:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character compound) often used in sports commentary and praise of skilled craftsmanship. The suffix ⟦{無比|むひ}→無比：23930_muhi⟧ (without equal) can combine with other words: ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦{無比|むひ}→無比：23930_muhi⟧ (unmatched courage), ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧⟦{無比|むひ}→無比：23930_muhi⟧ (unparalleled splendor).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正確無比|せいかくむひ}な⟦シュート→シュート：05926_shuuto⟧ (a pinpoint-accurate shot)
- {正確無比|せいかくむひ}な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ (unrivaled technique)
- {正確無比|せいかくむひ}な⟦{制御|せいぎょ}→制御：11816_seigyo⟧ (incomparably precise control)
